decision.reason: The changelog line [ev-da6dc6a7dbe9] says only "Fix log level". The linked PR [ev-004f35ff5f4a] adds only "Set up the right log level on the logger" and points to issue #9544, which is not shown. The changed-files list [ev-f2659d4f0f0a] names one file, cmd/traefik/logger.go. None of this says which setting is affected (for example the log.level option), what went wrong before the fix (configured level ignored? wrong default?), which configurations were exposed, or what an operator would see. Issue #9544 or the PR diff is needed to write the subject, change, applicability and consequence.
